g.text: Nhom A: Trigger LTF tai POI (khong doi HTF)
- Sweep STH/STL cung khung entry
- MSS + FVG cung khung, tai POI
- HTF pool CHUA bi cham
- Do: R-multiple, MFE/MAE
- Min. mau khuyen nghi: 30-50/thi truong
- Tieu chi thang: dong TP1 (T1) >= 1R
Nhom B: Cho HTF pool bi quet moi vao
- Cung POI, cung bias
- Chi vao SAU khi HTF pool bi wick qua
- Bo qua cac lan gia dao tu POI som
- Do: so lan "bo lo" so voi nhom A
- So sanh win-rate va missed-R hai nhom
- Muc tieu: dinh luong chi phi cua mismatch
Bien do luong (chuan hoa)
1) Khoang cach POI-to-pool / ATR(khung entry) -> phan loai "cung scale" (~1-2x ATR) vs "khac scale" (>3x ATR)
2) So nen hinh thanh pool (vai nen = LTF; hang gio/phien = HTF)
3) Ket qua R-multiple tai T1 (pool trung gian) va T2 (bo HTF thuc)
4) Nhan "sweep_target_named" (co goi ten pool cu the hay khong) - loai nhieu artifact mo phien
5) Phan tang theo instrument (NAS100 ATR lon vs EURUSD/GBPUSD/XAUUSD ATR nho) vi nguong scale khac nhau
Ket luan can backtest xac nhan truoc khi tin: day la KHUNG THI NGHIEM, khong phai so lieu that.
